build_SELayer: build a Squeeze-and-Excitation layer with given channels and squeeze ratio for channel-wise attention
build_DyReLU: build a Dynamic ReLU module with learnable slope and shift coefficients for activation
build_ChannelAttention: build a Channel Attention module using global average pooling and hardsigmoid activation
test_SELayer_forward: test the SELayer forward pass by passing a tensor and verifying output shape matches input
test_DyReLU_forward: test the DyReLU forward pass by splitting coefficients into a1, b1, a2, b2 and computing output
